name: John Beavan
story: Merrin Pearse worked on the realisation of NZGD2000, while John Beavan at the Institute of Geological and Nuclear Sciences contributed to the deformation modelling.
Rachelle Winefield, Chris Crook and John Beavan documented the deformation patch developed after the 2009 Fiordland earthquake and the method used to incorporate it into LINZ processing.
